CAMPAIGN_NAME: Copper mine tailings geochemistry study Repparfjorden Norway 1970s-2015
CAMPAIGN_COMMENT: Study investigates copper ore tailings deposited in Repparfjorden, Norway in the 1970s. Bathymetric analysis shows that tailings deposit still occurs as series of cone-shapes and has retained original shape for four decades. Analytical data of 51 chemical elements show tailings are spreading, affecting fjord surface sediments.
